title: Machina: An AI Agent Framework for Industrial Maintenance
description: Machina is an open-source Python framework for building AI agents specialized in industrial maintenance (predictive, preventive, corrective). It provides connectors for maintenance systems (CMMS, spreadsheets and SQL databases, IoT protocols, document stores, messaging), a canonical maintenance domain model, an LLM-powered agent layer with domain-aware prompting, and a Model Context Protocol server.
